title: Be careful!
text:
Be careful!. I like the product a lot, but I don't know that I would recommend using the refill bag. Why? (1) The original purchase of DampRid comes in a small plastic bucket shaped like a small flower pot with a plastic grill on the top. If you are not careful and happen to knock over one of these little containers when the beads inside have turned to liquid, you will find that a strange, oily, toxic liquid spills all over and is not easy to clean-up. Similarly, when you empty the little container, you are told to pour the contents into the toilet. If you are not careful or should happen to dislodge the plastic grill, when you upend the little container, the inside liner will fall into the toilet. You will have to fish-out these items while being sure to flush to get that oily liquid out of the basin. (2) It is a toxic substance. Most of us with kids and pets are not fond of using toxic substances in our home unless absolutely necessary.

I do like DampRid but plan to dispose of the empty container rather than refill it due to the problems if a spill should happen or other accident.
